name: Featured series grid shows cover images and metadata
description: The Trending right now section renders a grid of six series cards, each with an actual cover image, a title, and genre/series metadata — none missing or broken.

planSteps.description: Scroll to the section headed Trending right now
The section shows six series cards: Static Shores, Neon Requiem, Cadence, The Void Archive, Last Call, and Embers and Ash
Each of the six cards displays an actual photo-like cover image (not a blank or broken image) along with its title, and a genre plus an episode count such as 94 eps
Each card shows a star rating, and hovering over or moving the mouse across a card makes it tilt in 3D on the cover
